data.title: Electricity contract confirmation "MusterStrom Flex"
data.summary: Stadtwerke Musterstadt GmbH confirms your electricity supply contract "MusterStrom Flex" for Beispielweg 5, starting 1 October 2025 with a 12-month initial term. The monthly advance payment is €48.00, due on the 15th.
data.explanation: This letter confirms your new electricity contract. Supply started on 1 October 2025 and the initial term runs to 30 September 2026. It can be cancelled with one month's notice to the end of the initial term; the app computes the cancellation deadline. If you don't cancel, it continues indefinitely and can then be cancelled at any time with one month's notice. You pay €48.00 per month by direct debit on the 15th. You were asked to report the meter reading at the start of supply by 5 October 2025. Check that this was done.
